# Requirements Viewer for VS Code

> A VS Code extension for viewing requirements inside the editor and sidebar.

## Core Features
- On-hover display of requirements data.
- Panel for displaying requirements for the active open file.
- Caching for fast requirement recall.
- Secure storage of secrets.
- Multi-provider architecture (Jama Connect supported currently).

## Target Use Cases
- Medical device, automotive, and aerospace code compliance.
- Requirements traceability directly inside developer IDEs.

## Supported Software
- Jama Connect

## Future Plans
- Adding more providers as people ask for them.
